description: Department  of Fiscal Policy - Order made to declare that an Excise Duty on Waters, Beer, Cigarettes, etc. be payable and a Concessionary Excise Duty on purchase of Motor Vehicles. etc. and the applicable rates for the purpose of calculating the Excise Duty on Motor Vehicles, etc. w.e.f. 11.11.2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of excise duty rates through a statutory order under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989. It contains detailed regulatory changes to tax rates on various goods (beverages, tobacco, petroleum products, refrigerators) and rescinds previous orders. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, this is incidental to the regulatory function - the core content is about legal/regulatory changes to taxation frameworks, not about government personnel or organizational structure. The detailed schedules specifying tax rates and product classifications clearly fall under legal/regulatory matters.
